task: pick up the bbq sauce and place it in the basket

windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the bbq sauce bottle on the table.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the red bbq sauce bottle.
Approach the bbq sauce from above, lowering the open gripper toward its cap.
Approach the bbq sauce from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Grasp the bbq sauce bottle from above, closing the gripper fingers around its body.
Grasp the bbq sauce bottle from above and lift it off the table.
Lift the bbq sauce bottle up off the floor, raising it above the surrounding objects.
Carry the bbq sauce horizontally across the table toward the basket.
Carry the bbq sauce horizontally across the table toward the basket.
Carry the bbq sauce horizontally over the table toward the basket.
Lower the bbq sauce bottle down into the basket.
Release the bbq sauce into the basket and open the gripper fingers.
Release the bbq sauce into the basket and retract the empty gripper upward.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the basket.
